learning_pipeline.name: Discover
learning_pipeline.desc: Deconstruct real user friction, identify campus bottlenecks, and validate viable product hypotheses before writing a line of code.

learning_pipeline.name: Prototype
learning_pipeline.desc: Craft high-fidelity design systems with tactile micro-interactions, dark mode tokens, and fluid component hierarchies.

learning_pipeline.name: Collaborate
learning_pipeline.desc: Pair program in agile squads where Flutter engineers, UI designers, and QA testers coordinate in real time.

learning_pipeline.name: Build
learning_pipeline.desc: Engineered with Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, SQLite, Supabase and WebSocket streams, prioritizing 60fps responsiveness.

learning_pipeline.name: Ship
learning_pipeline.desc: Automated build pipelines, APK distributions, TestFlight releases, and verified campus rollouts.

highlights.title: Formats nobody else runs
highlights.text: A Git escape room that unlocks a hackathon. A competition for useless apps. Game genres drawn from a bowl. We design events people remember.

highlights.title: Build, then pitch
highlights.text: Most of our events end the same way: you build something real under time pressure, then stand up and explain it.

highlights.title: Run by students
highlights.text: Eleven students across leadership, program, project, marketing and review run every event end to end.

why_lead: Whether you are writing your first line of code or already shipping apps, MAD gives you the events, the projects and the people to build with.

why.title: Ship things
why.text: Hackathons, build challenges and club projects where the output is a working app, not a certificate.

why.title: Learn the real tools
why.text: Git, Flutter, Unity, Figma and AI-assisted development, used under real deadlines.

why.title: Run events
why.text: Join a committee and help design, market and run events like Appsylum and Git Out.

why.title: Find your crew
why.text: Meet designers, developers and organisers from across NHCE who like building as much as you do.

cta_title: Ready to craft apps that matter?
cta_text: Follow us on Instagram for the next event, or reach the core team directly.

about.manifesto_quote: Don't just use the future. Build it.
about.who: MAD Club (Mobile App Development Club) is a student-led club at New Horizon College of Engineering, Bengaluru. Started in 2023, it runs hackathons, build challenges and design events, and brings together students who want to make apps.
about.objective: Give students hands-on practice beyond the syllabus: building apps, working in teams, using real tools like Git, and pitching what they made.
about.outcomes: Practical experience with industry tools (Git, Flutter, Unity, Figma), projects worth showing, and the confidence to pitch your work.

timeline.title: Founded · Mindspark'23
timeline.desc: The club starts with its first flagship: WikiWhiz, UI Clash and CodeMaze.

timeline.title: InnoWave, TechSync & Connect'24
timeline.desc: Pitch rounds, a cross-club event and a showcase day for the club's builders.

timeline.title: Codathon, Pixel Pursuit & Appsylum
timeline.desc: A coding marathon, a UI sprint, and Appsylum: the Useless App Competition, in December.

timeline.title: Game Design & Git Out
timeline.desc: A game-dev challenge with genres drawn from a bowl, and a Git escape room that unlocks a hackathon.

committees.name: Program Committee
committees.desc: Designs competitive rounds, curates hackathon problem statements, coordinates technical mentors, and manages stage operations.

committees.name: Project Committee
committees.desc: Architects club internal tooling, conducts hands-on code labs in Flutter/Native stacks, and oversees member app development.

committees.name: Marketing Committee
committees.desc: Crafts visual brand identity, motion teasers, Instagram campaigns, and runs the club's Instagram.

committees.name: Review Committee
committees.desc: Conducts code audits, evaluates hackathon submissions, assesses technical rubrics, and ensures flawless event delivery.
